scope: Algorithm-first Web demo: semantic portrait retouching and segmented body reshape
limitations: CPU WASM/native; no GPU or large-image performance acceptance
Pose person alpha is model segmentation, not precise matting or body-part parsing
Face contour still uses full-photo inverse sampling; independent foreground reshape not implemented for faces
No automatic skin/hair/clothing parsing; 2D feature symmetry is conservative
No generative object/person removal or complex background reconstruction
Changing upstream geometry/order requires renewed detection
visualQualityAcceptance: Single front-facing/crossed-arm portrait inspected; multi-pose, multi-skin-tone and full-body quality not yet accepted
warning: Old pixel-change-only results do not establish retouching quality. See current per-algorithm contracts and real-photo failures.
